dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Video Settings ComboBox not exposed in the WinUI UIA automation tree, so the scoring parity/structural gate could not confirm the control; scenario downgraded pass->partial (score 83, 2/3 coverage).
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: none - not a stuck loop; the agent never added an automation Name to these ComboBoxes
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The ComboBoxes carry only Name + PlaceholderText and no AutomationProperties.Name/Header. In WinUI 3 a ComboBox whose only visible label is PlaceholderText does not surface a stable UIA Name until an item is selected, so automation/parity tooling cannot find it. The agent did add AutomationProperties.Name to the ListBox nav control and to the preview Image, but not to the placeholder-labelled ComboBoxes.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A prominent skill rule that every interactive control must expose a stable AutomationProperties.Name (or Header/AutomationId) after migration, calling out placeholder-only ComboBox/ListBox/TextBox as the common trap. Currently the only mention of preserving AutomationProperties is buried in a single CaptureElement example.
